body.name: Exact algebraic certificate-complexity handle
body.construction: Use signed subresultant sequences for the cubic presentation \(\mathbb Q(\alpha_n)\), cache common denominators across the eight-type orbit sums, and refine rational isolating intervals only at comparison nodes in the minimum over allocation counts. The target object is a bit-complexity bound for producing a width-\(\delta\) enclosure of \(B_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger\).
